articles.title: Car flips after multi-vehicle crash on Don Valley Parkway
articles.summary: Emergency crews are at the scene of a multi-vehicle collision on the northbound Don Valley Parkway. Toronto police say the crash happened just after 3 p.m. near the Prince Edward Viaduct. One vehicle has flipped on its roof. Paramedics say at least one person was transported to a hospital with minor injuries. The left and […]

articles.title: 2 motorcyclists seriously injured in Markham crash
articles.summary: Two motorcyclists have been taken to the hospital following a two-vehicle crash in Markham. Police in York Region say the crash occurred just after 1:30 p.m. in the Markham Road and Denison Street area. A motorcyclist and their passenger were taken to the hospital with serious injuries. No other injuries were reported. An investigation is […]

articles.title: Feds’ rejection of island airport plan prevents waterfront ‘destruction’: advocates
articles.summary: The federal government's decision to halt Ontario's plan for a major expansion of Billy Bishop airport will guard Toronto's waterfront against serious setbacks to its revitalization, advocates say.

articles.title: Small businesses file lawsuits against Trump’s new sweeping tariffs
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Trump's tariffs are headed to court — again.

articles.title: SIU investigates early morning crash in Etobicoke: police
articles.summary: Ontario's police watchdog is investigating a crash that took place in Etobicoke early Saturday morning, said Toronto police.

articles.title: Scarborough man charged with murder, 2 others wanted in fatal Brampton shooting last month
articles.summary: One man is in custody, and police are searching for two other suspects in connection with a fatal shooting in Brampton last month. articles.title: Man, 37, facing murder charge in shooting death of 26-year-old woman in Rexdale
articles.summary: A 37-year-old man is facing a murder charge after a woman was shot and killed outside a home in Rexdale early Friday morning. Toronto police say a man and a woman were having a brief interaction just before 7:30 a.m. on Arborwood Drive in the Humberwood Boulevard and Rexdale Boulevard area when shots rang out. […]

articles.title: 3 people arrested after car flees police leading to serious crash in Etobicoke
articles.summary: Three people were arrested in connection with a serious car crash that happened in Etobicoke early Saturday morning. Authorities say an Acura carrying two teens and an 18-year-old male fled from police during a traffic stop just after midnight. articles.title: The Lower Don Trail is reopening after years of delays — but it's not quite finished yet
articles.summary: The section of Toronto’s Lower Don Trail between the Belleville Underpass and Queen Street East will reopen on Aug. 1. The reopening follows years of delays caused by unsuitable soil conditions and weather.

articles.title: Federal government says it won't support Ontario's Billy Bishop Airport expansion plans
articles.summary: The federal government says it won't support Ontario Premier Doug Ford's plan to expand Billy Bishop Airport to allow jets to take off and land there.

articles.title: Police investigate suspicious fire outside Richmond Hill home
articles.summary: Police are investigating a suspicious fire that took place in the driveway of a Richmond Hill home early Friday morning.

articles.title: Victim identified, suspected arrested after fatal shooting in Etobicoke: police
articles.summary: Toronto police say they have arrested a man in connection to the fatal shooting of a 26-year-old woman in Etobicoke Friday morning.

articles.title: Toronto's newest park is getting an expansion the size of 4 Canadian football fields
articles.summary: Just a year after one of Toronto's newest parks first opened to the public, Biidaasige Park is being expanded on Friday to include four more hectares.

articles.title: More than 1,000 scrap tires are piled at this Toronto auto shop. No recyclers will take them, owner says
articles.summary: A Scarborough auto repair shop owner says he has been told by the city to clear more than a thousand scrap tires from his business, but he cannot get anyone to pick them up following changes to provincial tire recycling rules.

articles.title: Burglars posing as landscapers behind string of break-ins in Durham Region: police
articles.summary: Durham Regional Police are warning residents after a string of break-ins they say were committed by suspects posing as landscapers.
